reason: A client UI plugin that provides a floating outline drawer for navigating user messages in the current DeepSeek Harness conversation, with history loading and scroll-position highlighting.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话提供悬浮导航按钮和大纲抽屉，用于浏览、定位并跟随用户消息。
summaries.en: Provides a floating navigation button and outline drawer for browsing, jumping to, and tracking user messages in the current DeepSeek Harness conversation.

capabilities: Loads older conversation events to display full history
Adds an in-client floating navigation button and drawer
Scrolls to selected user messages and tracks the visible conversation position
